draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Juhu! On 15 October 1932, J. R. D. Tata landed his little Puss Moth at Juhu carrying mail from Karachi, starting India's first scheduled commercial mail service.
draft.hungryLine: My notes don't name a place to eat in Juhu, but Mumbai's beaches fill up with food stalls in the evenings.

moodReplies.show-me-around: St. Joseph's Church is 2 minutes away, Vile Parle is about 13 minutes on foot, and Juhu Aerodrome is around 20 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Juhu Beach in the evening and watch how locals spend their Sunday, with food and game stalls everywhere.
moodReplies.surprise-me: In 1972 a Japan Air Lines DC-8 landed at Juhu Aerodrome instead of the much larger Santacruz airport and overran the runway. All 122 people on board survived.

spots.name: St. Joseph's Church, Juhu
spots.detail: 2 min walk · Juhu's neighbourhood Catholic church

spots.name: Vile Parle
spots.detail: 13 min walk · The suburb where the first Parle factory stood

spots.name: Juhu Aerodrome
spots.detail: 20 min walk · One of India's first civil airports, from 1928

tips.title: Stay out of the water in the rains.
tips.body: The currents don't look strong, but many people drown off Mumbai's beaches, especially in the monsoon.

tips.title: Dress for a city beach.
tips.body: Mumbai beaches aren't the place for swimsuits, so keep it casual and covered.

story.title: Captured by a general
story.body: The Marathi text Mahikavatichi Bakhar says Juhu was captured by king Pratap Bimb's general Balkrishnrao Somvanshi in the 12th century.

story.title: A sandbar island
story.body: In the 19th century Juhu was an island, a long narrow sand bar rising just a metre or two above the sea.

story.title: The mail flight
story.body: J. R. D. Tata landed at Juhu Aerodrome with a load of mail, launching India's first scheduled commercial mail service.

story.title: Airport moves east
story.body: Commercial flights moved to the bigger Santa Cruz airport, built 2 km east during the war. Juhu now handles Mumbai's helicopters.

story.title: Beach of the stars
story.body: Juhu is one of the city's most affluent areas and home to many Bollywood celebrities.
